instruments.title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (Artificial Intelligence Act): provisions on general-purpose AI models, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 where it touches them
instruments.standingNote: A regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council. Chapter V (Articles 51 to 56) and Article 101 are the provisions compared.

instruments.title: General-Purpose AI Code of Practice, Safety and Security chapter
instruments.standingNote: Not binding in itself: under Articles 53(4) and 55(2) of the AI Act, providers may rely on codes of practice to demonstrate compliance. Included because the task names it as the Act’s stated means of compliance. Its commitments are those of signatories that choose to adhere to it. The chapter itself is undated; the dataset’s Code sources give 10 July 2025 as the publication date on the Commission’s Code page, which this pack did not re-inspect.

instruments.title: California SB 53 (Chapter 138, Statutes of 2025), Transparency in Frontier Artificial Intelligence Act
New York RAISE Act as signed: S6953-B, Chapter 699 of 2025
instruments.standingNote: Signed as Chapter 699 of 2025. Chapter 96 of 2026 repeals and re-adds Article 44-B, which Chapter 699 added, and amends its section 3 on effect, according to the S8828 summary line. The cells record the Chapter 699 text as signed. Whether that text took effect before Chapter 96 was signed is not settled by the texts read (see Q11).

instruments.title: New York RAISE Act as amended: S8828 / A9449, Chapter 96 of 2026
instruments.standingNote: Chapter amendment signed 27 March 2026; its text is read in the Assembly’s bill record (the bill as printed), not in the session laws.

instruments.title: Illinois Public Act 104-0538 (SB 315, 104th General Assembly), Artificial Intelligence Safety Measures Act
instruments.standing: binding; signed according to Executive Order 2026-07
instruments.standingNote: Cells drafted from the saved text of the enacted act (sources/il-pa-104-0538.txt, from the Internet Archive capture of the official PDF). The approval date (Q10) quotes the bill status record from the cross-family checker’s copy.

instruments.title: 生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法 (Interim Measures for the Management of Generative Artificial Intelligence Services), 2023
instruments.standingNote: Departmental rules issued by order of seven authorities (Order No. 15). They address providers of generative AI services to the public in China, not model developers as such; the comparison records what they require of providers.

instruments.title: 人工智能生成合成内容标识办法 (Measures for Labelling AI-Generated Synthetic Content), 2025
instruments.standingNote: Measures issued by four authorities by notice 国信办通字〔2025〕2号. They address service providers and others; the mandatory national standard GB 45438-2025 on labelling methods, which they refer to, is not compared separately (its text was not retrieved).

instruments.title: Executive Order 14110 (30 October 2023), section 4.2 and related provisions
instruments.standingNote: An executive order directing federal agencies; its developer reporting duties were to be imposed by the Secretary of Commerce. Revoked by Executive Order 14148 of 20 January 2025. Recorded as a historical row.

instruments.title: Framework for Artificial Intelligence Diffusion (BIS interim final rule, 90 FR 4544, 15 January 2025)
instruments.standingNote: An export-control rule. The Department of Commerce announced on 13 May 2025 that it had initiated a rescission; no Federal Register rule formalising the rescission was inspected.
